changes: Amudi removed site navigation, editing controls, dynamically transcluded separate commentary panels, non-text media and style/script markup; converted the remaining Midrash reading text to plain chapter JSON, adding whitespace between blocks and escaping markup characters. Source passages, their order and source omission notices are retained. No OCR or new translation. Copyrightable adaptations remain under CC BY-SA 4.0.
coverageStatus: 330 source-indexed passage pages across 37 chapters; two pages are empty and two explicitly report missing text. Chapter 6 uses different passage numbering from the other Amudi edition. No independent whole-work or English-translation completeness is claimed.
